subject.why: Two pink lawn flamingos with metal legs are clearly depicted, complete with the requested blue bow on one of them.

category.why: The camera angle is shot straight-on at eye level rather than from a low, heroic angle, and the tall hedge fills the midground instead of keeping the setting to a simple strip at the bottom.

clean.why: No text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters are present.

framing.why: The flamingo pair is centered with comfortable margins on all sides and nothing important is cut off.

colour.why: Vibrant, warm pinks and saturated greens stand out cleanly against the bright blue sky.

detail.why: Chunky, stylized shapes without excessive micro-textures or busy clutter.

style.why: Matches the reference style with soft satin sheen, smooth 3D volumes, and no visible outlines.

fix: Lower the camera angle to make the flamingos look big and heroic against the blue sky, reducing the lawn and hedge to a low strip at the bottom.
